theme_strategy.description: Futuristic AI Life Operating System Dashboard with a 'Terminal/HUD' retro-futurism aesthetic mixed with modern sleekness. High contrast, neon accents against deep navy void.
theme_strategy.anti_pattern_avoidance: No flat generic SaaS gradients. No muddy gray backgrounds. Use stark technical grid lines, distinct glowing boundaries, and high-contrast typographic hierarchy.

rules.branding: Use 'Unbounded' only for the 'Hub3 JARVIS' logo and major hero numbers to give an elite tech vibe.
rules.labels: Inter Uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] (small caps effect) for all sub-labels, card headers, and device statuses.
rules.metrics: Massive bold numbers (e.g., text-5xl font-black) using Inter or Unbounded. High contrast.
rules.anti_pattern: Do not center align standard text or paragraphs. Left-align for technical HUD precision.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: High Density Grid for Dashboards. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-8. Tightly packed widgets with gap-4 or gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar (w-64 or w-72) for navigation, distinct from the main canvas.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Use generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) inside the cards before content begins.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Numbers should align by decimal or right-edge if stacked.

cards.corner_brackets: Subtle corner brackets (absolute positioned 2x2 px borders or SVG segments at the 4 corners of cards) colored in #00D4FF. This is CRITICAL for the HUD aesthetic.
cards.radius: rounded-lg or rounded-xl (subtle roundness, max 12px), but corner brackets give it a sharp technical look.

buttons.primary: Solid #FF8C42 with hover:bg-orange-400 and box-shadow glow.
buttons.secondary: Border 1px #00D4FF with transparent bg, text #00D4FF. Hover: bg-cyan-900/30.

icons.style: Circular icons wrapped in a halo of the area's color (e.g., bg-cyan-500/20 with border border-cyan-500/50 and text-cyan-400).

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Use Framer Motion for micro-animations on all cards and transitions.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and cyan glow intensifies (shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,212,255,0.2)]).
motion_and_interactions.waveforms: Animated waveform bars (CSS keyframes scaling Y-axis) for the 'Ei Hub' button and 'Speaker' device cards. Color: #00D4FF.
motion_and_interactions.neural_graph: React Force Graph (react-force-graph-2d) with floating particles connecting 8 nodes to the central Hub3. Links should glow cyan/orange.

layout_1_life_os.main_viz: AI Brain Network animated graph in center.
layout_1_life_os.ei_hub_button: Pill button with waveform animation indicating voice readiness.
layout_1_life_os.consensus_panel: Breakdown of 8 models using progress bars (gradient cyan->orange).

layout_2_consensus.diagram: Flow diagram connecting 7 model cards to a central orange gear ('Consensus Engine').
layout_2_consensus.components: Voting mechanism displays, cost optimization metrics, response score indicators.

cards: Smart Lights: Circular color wheel interface
Thermostat: Circular dial interface (SVG or Framer Motion rotate)
Wearable Health: Heart rate graph (Recharts or simple SVG path)
Smart Plugs: List with orange toggles

layout_4_chat.structure: WhatsApp-like layout. Left sidebar with conversations (badges for unread). Main chat area.
layout_4_chat.messages: Bubbles with corner brackets. Inline action cards rendered inside the chat flow.
layout_4_chat.input: Bottom input bar with attach, emoji, send button (orange).

ai_avatar.description: Close-up of a futuristic humanoid robot with blue LED eyes, used for the main AI JARVIS avatar.

user_avatar.description: User profile avatar for chat or top nav.

security_camera.description: Modern living room view used for the Smart Home Security Camera card.

smart_tv.description: Cinematic TV screen used for the Smart TV control card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark navy background (#0A0E27) and card backgrounds (#0F1729).

Implement the 'corner brackets' on cards using absolute positioned divs or pseudo-elements (::before/::after) with 1px border colored #00D4FF on the corners of the cards. This is a critical HUD visual requirement.
Do NOT use raw generic HTML <select>, <input date> etc. Use custom styled components mimicking Shadcn structure if building from scratch, heavily customized to the HUD theme.
Implement the PT/EN language toggle in the header/sidebar.
Ensure 'Ei Hub' button has a real CSS animation making 3-4 vertical bars scale up and down to represent a voice waveform.
Install and integrate `react-force-graph-2d` for the AI Brain Network in Layout 1.
For the Progress bars, strictly use `bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00D4FF] to-[#FF8C42]`.
Install `lucide-react` for icons if not present, and render them inside a circular div with `bg-cyan-500/10` and `border border-cyan-500/30`.
Add `data-testid` to all toggles, buttons, and navigation items.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glowing drop-shadows rather than flat borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use SVGs/Lucide.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='smart-lights-toggle').
